notes: Range Sessions redesigned to match the visual concept that started the React redesign: visual session cards, firearm photos, round totals, ammunition chips, filters, visual add/edit form, and richer session drawer.
Firearm drawer tabs are functional: Overview, Details, Maintenance, and Documents now render meaningful firearm-specific content.
Firearm card action menu is functional with View Details, Edit Firearm, and Archive Firearm.
Reserve-by-Caliber card accent now uses the exact same centralized status tone as its progress bar.
Firearm card footer retains meaningful photo/document/readiness icons and semantic readiness color.
Adds roadmap documentation for a future image-processing pipeline: original preservation, EXIF normalization, WebP derivatives, metadata, and context-appropriate image sizes.
